csv_project_name: Architectural Service for Pinewood Housing Development Proj
csv_scope_of_work: CTLA is seeking Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from highly qualified architectural firms interested in providing complete architectural design services for the Pinewood Housing Development Project. The purpose of this RFQ is to select and contract with one (1) Architectural/Engineering firm to provide the required professional service. CTLA is seeking proposals from professionally licensed and qualified architectural firms to provide comprehensive design services for the Pinewood Housing Development, located at the intersection of Pinewood Village Drive and Hwy 165 in Kinder, Louisian. CTLA seeks to develop homes that meet the following design requirements: FortifiedTM Roof Certified Energy Star Home Certified Net Zero Energy Ready Home. The selected Architect shall be responsible for providing professional design services including Schematic Design, Design Development, Construction Documents, Bidding, Construction Administration and a One-Year Correction Period Inspection. Proposers are expected to assemble a Project Team of consultants and subconsultants as required to provide necessary services.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management
